jp: なぜ浮かない顔をする？
en: What's wrong, Grisina? Why the long face?

jp: 何もかも順調に進んでいる
en: No need to worry. Everything is going exactly to plan, isn't it!
Or does... the wound still hurt?

jp: 私に触らないで下さい
en: Please do not touch me.
Guh...
...Now then, you two.

jp: 私にかまわず、感動の再会を
en: Why not forget about me and enjoy your touching reunion?

jp: どうせ殺す気なんでしょ？
en: You mean to kill us anyway, don't you?
Yes, that's right.

jp: だからこそ残された時間を
楽しんだらどうですか？
en: All the more reason to enjoy the time you have left, don't you think?
...Stay-neesan.
It's all right. I'll think of something.

jp: 根拠の無い希望を持つと、
あとで悲しい想いをしますよ
en: Heh heh heh heh... Cling to baseless hope, and it will only hurt more later.

jp: 私たちをどうするつもり？
en: What do you plan to do with us?

jp: すぐに殺さないってことは
私たちは誰かをおびき出すための
en: You haven't killed us yet, so we're hostages to lure someone out, aren't we?
How perceptive.

jp: 貴方たちは大切なゲスト
今はまだ殺しはしません
en: You are precious guests. I won't kill you just yet.

jp: こんな回りくどいことをして
いったい誰が目的なの？
en: Going to all this trouble... Who is it you're really after?
Isn't it obvious! The white-wing brat who wounded Grisina!!
White-wing brat?
That's right! He's one of yours, isn't he!!
One of mine... You can't mean Cain?

jp: 忌々しいヤツめ！そいつは
グリシナの顔に傷をつけた
en: That accursed wretch! He is the great sinner who scarred Grisina's face!!

jp: そんなことでカインを
en: A scar on the face... That's why you hate Cain so much?
What would you know!!

jp: 生まれながら「女」だったお前に
私の気持ちがわかるものか！！
en: You were born a "woman"! How could you ever understand how I feel!!

jp: 女に勝る存在になりたかった
女でないことを忘れさせるほど
en: I wanted to surpass women. To be so beautiful it made everyone forget I was not one.

jp: 何もなかったのに・・・・・
en: It was all I had... All I had......
You should all just die. You, Cardia, and that brat too!!

jp: アンタ達の仲間じゃない
en: Cardia-neesan isn't one of you.
Oh, but she is... Only until today, though.
What do you mean?

jp: 異端者を助けようとすれば
en: Kin or not, anyone who tries to help a heretic is guilty of treason.

jp: カインとカルディア、両方
一緒に殺してしまいましょうか
en: If possible, yes... Cain and Cardia. Let's kill them both together, shall we?
You meant to kill them both from the start!
That's right.
No...

jp: どうやら大切なゲストが
到着されたみたいですね
en: Heh heh heh. It seems our precious guests have arrived.
Stayen! And Kilota too!?
Lilis-chan!?

jp: ステイエンを返してもらうよ！
en: We're taking Stayen back!

jp: 己の力量も分からぬ愚か者め！
貴様などひねりつぶしてくれる！
en: Hmph! A fool who doesn't know his own measure! I'll crush you like a bug!

jp: あのゴツイ天使・・・
en: That hulking angel... That's the one Cardia told us about...

jp: ええ、間違いありません
力天使レッド・ムフロンです
en: No doubt about it. He's one of the Ten Tribunal Generals, the Virtue Red Mouflon.

jp: 小僧、待ちわびたぞ・・
我がグリシナを傷つけた罪
死をもって償ってもらう！！
en: Brat, I've waited long for this.. You'll pay for wounding my Grisina with your life!!
The crime of wounding...?

jp: 忘れたとは言わせんぞ！
貴様がグリシナの美しい顔に
en: Don't tell me you've forgotten! You're the one who scarred Grisina's beautiful face!
You're... that angel from back then.
Ah, and you are...

jp: 尻尾を巻いて逃げ去った
女悪魔じゃないですか？
en: The she-demon who ran off with her tail between her legs, aren't you?

jp: 殺されに来たのですか？
en: Have you come to be killed properly this time?

jp: 死ぬのはアンタの方だよ
en: You're the one who's gonna die.

jp: ずいぶん威勢のいいこと
en: Heh heh.. Aren't we full of spirit.

jp: でないとこの者たちの命は
en: Drop your weapons! Or I cannot guarantee these people's lives!!

jp: 人質をとられた時点で
en: You should have seen this coming the moment we took hostages.

jp: 裏をかくつもりだった、でしょ？
en: That's why you had friends lying in wait to outflank us. Didn't you?

jp: 大人しく出てきなさい！
でないと人質を殺しますよ？
en: Come out quietly! Or I'll kill a hostage.
Ugh!
Stayen!!
There are two hostages, after all. One of them dying is no great loss.
Stop it!!

jp: 俺たちならここにいる
en: We're right here.
...Sorry, everyone.
...Zion. ...Exal.

jp: 大人しく武器を捨てなさい
en: You too. Drop your weapons quietly.
...Damn it.

jp: まだ一人いるはずです
灰色の翼の天使はどこですか？
en: There should be one more. Where is the grey-winged angel?

jp: 姿を現さないのなら・・・
en: If he will not show himself...
Johannes isn't here!!

jp: ヨハネはまだ傷が・・・
en: Johannes's wounds still haven't...
...... Well, fine.

jp: 規格外が一人増えたところで
en: One more irregular hardly makes a difference, I'd say.

jp: これからどうしようっていうの？
en: ...So? What do you plan to do now?

jp: フフフ・・・そうですね
楽しい遊びでもしましょうか
en: Heh heh heh... Let me see. Shall we play a fun little game?

jp: 遊びなどと悠長なことを
en: Games? There's no time for such leisure.

jp: こいつを殺さねば気がすまん！！
en: I won't be satisfied until I kill this one, right here and now!!
Your grudge is against me alone, right?
...Yes.

jp: 他のみんなは関係ない
en: Then the others have nothing to do with this.

jp: みんなを解放してあげて
en: Kill me instead, and let everyone else go.
Cain-san, what are you..?
You idiot, Cain! What do you think you're doing!!

jp: ボクの代わりにみんなを・・
en: Please. Take me, and let everyone else..

jp: 殊勝な心がけだな小僧！
en: Fwahahaha! How admirable of you, brat!
As you wish, I'll kill you!!
Nooooooo!!!
Cain!!
Hrgh!
Fwahahahahaha!!
Cain!!
...No. This can't be real.

jp: 殺してしまうなんて・・・
en: What a hopeless man. Losing control and killing him like that...

jp: 死ねっ死ねっ死ねぇぇっ！！！
en: Fwahahaha!! Die! Die! Diiiie!!

jp: お願いだからもうやめて！！！
en: Please... Please, stop it!! Cain's going to die!

jp: 大人しくしてなさい・・
en: Behave yourself, like a proper hostage..

jp: 貴方たちは無力なんですから
en: Scream all you like. You are powerless.
Fwahahahahaha!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
